final:
type Chan = { cap: int, used: int }

-- Reports whether a send can be accepted without blocking.
send_ready(c: Chan) -> bool =
  post out == (c.used < c.cap)
  ex send_ready(Chan(cap: 2, used: 2)) == False
  ex send_ready(Chan(cap: 2, used: 0)) == True
  c.used < c.cap

-- Attempts to send every element of xs without blocking, then stops at the
-- first refused send. Returns how many sends were accepted.
accepted(cap: int, xs: List[int]) -> int uses nondet =
  pre cap >= 0
  post out >= 0 and out <= cap and out <= xs.len()
  ex accepted(0, [1, 2]) == 0
  ex accepted(5, [1, 2]) == 2
  var c = Chan(cap: cap, used: 0)
  var n = 0
  for i in range(0, xs.len())
    if not send_ready(c)
      break
    c.used += 1
    n += 1
  n
